name: mirroir-mcp
description: Drive a stock iPhone via iPhone Mirroring: no Developer Mode, Xcode or WDA. LLM-free skill replay.
long_description: mirroir-mcp drives a real iPhone through the macOS iPhone Mirroring window. describe_screen returns OCR'd text with tap coordinates; tap, swipe, drag, type_text, launch_app and open_url act on the device; generate_skill explores an app and authors replayable skills. The bundle carries the native Apple Silicon server inside a small app, mirroir-mcp.app, so it starts without Node or a network fetch. Requires macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon and a paired iPhone in iPhone Mirroring. Claude starts the server as its own process, so macOS asks for Screen Recording and Accessibility for "mirroir-mcp" (the robot icon), not for Claude: turn it on in System Settings > Privacy & Security, then quit and reopen Claude. The bundle is signed ad hoc, so macOS may ask again after an extension update.

debug_logging.title: Debug logging
debug_logging.description: Log every tool call to ~/.mirroir-mcp/debug.log (each line names the process that wrote it). Turn on when reporting a problem.
